$comment: Cross-OS installer capability parity matrix. CI compares this against actual installer flag detection (scripts/check-installer-parity.js). Add new flags here when supported by both Mac and Windows installers.

capabilities.name: fresh
capabilities.description: Reset MCP customizations to template (destructive merge)

capabilities.name: allow-partial
capabilities.description: Continue on npm install / build failures

capabilities.name: force
capabilities.description: Allow destructive update operations (Windows only — Mac uses FORCE_UPDATE env var)

capabilities.name: update
capabilities.description: Run update flow (Windows only — Mac uses scripts/update.sh)
